sections.heading: What a High-Mileage Engine Rebuild Involves

blocks.html: An engine that has covered many miles accumulates wear across its internal components. A high-mileage rebuild is a comprehensive process that addresses this wear through:

items: **Full strip-down inspection** — every component is measured against manufacturer tolerances.
**Precision machining** — cylinder boring and honing, crankshaft grinding, and cylinder head resurfacing.
**Replacement of all wear items** — pistons, rings, bearings, timing components, seals, oil pump, and water pump.
**Thorough cleaning** — oil galleries and cooling passages are cleared of contamination.
**Quality assurance** — pressure testing and final assembly to exacting standards.

blocks.html: Every rebuild is carried out in our fully equipped workshop, using genuine or OEM-grade parts and adhering to BS AU257:2002 for remanufactured engines.

items.q: What is considered "high mileage" for a Land Rover engine?
items.a: We consider an engine to be high-mileage when it has accumulated significant wear, typically beyond 100,000 miles. However, the need for a rebuild depends on the engine's condition, service history, and how it has been driven. We assess each engine individually during our inspection.

items.q: Will a high-mileage rebuild restore my engine to "as new" condition?
items.a: Our rebuild process replaces all wear items and machines components to manufacturer tolerances. While we cannot reverse structural damage to the block or crank if beyond repair, in most cases the engine will perform and last like new. We'll advise if a replacement is a better option.

items.q: How long does a high-mileage rebuild take?
items.a: Typically 3–5 working days from arrival at our workshop, depending on the engine type and required machining. We'll give you a clear timeline when we provide the quote.

items.q: Is a high-mileage rebuild always cheaper than replacing the engine?
items.a: Often yes, especially for older or rare engines. However, we always assess both options and provide a transparent comparison. We never recommend a rebuild if a replacement is genuinely more cost-effective or reliable.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on high-mileage rebuilds?
items.a: Yes, every engine rebuild comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. This covers parts and labour for any defect arising from the rebuild work.
